universe_rule: Every active native crypto USDC spot with corresponding active same-underlying perp in archived catalogue, exclude tokenized equities/gold and inactive AZTEC. No funding-based asset selection. Current-survivor/development universe, not historical listing proof.
window: September1 00:00 to October1 00:00 UTC, 720 exact hourly rows; boundary events excluded separately per interval
direction: Long funded spot and short perp fixed for every asset, no reverse direction or borrowed spot
hurdle: 5% simple annual capital on2x principal, plus5bp stress per interval; Standard public zero fees scenario. No collateral solvency, basis, execution, or cashflow inference. ETH shares same2x scenario here for comparability.
classification: Historical exploratory development, all42 asset/block rows retained, fullmonth overlaps diagnostics. Positive rows require separate candle/execution/collateral work, not automatic collector or promotion.
